cohort: The study included 162 full-term neonates (>=259 days gestational age) delivered by Cesarean section due to decreased fetal heart rate.
finding: There was a positive correlation between UApH and both 1-min and 5-min Apgar scores, and mild acidemia (UApH<7.2) in male fetuses was a good predictor for postnatal complications and NICU admission.
birth_weight: Birth weight was measured and controlled for, with boys having higher weight (P=0.033) than girls; no overall cohort range or mean specified.
